an5.169:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] atha kho āyasmā ānando yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.
an5.169:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca:
an5.169:2.1: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu, suggahitagāhī ca, bahuṃ ca gaṇhāti, gahitaṃ cassa nappamussatī?ti.
an5.169:2.4: tenahāvuso sāriputta, suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmīti.
an5.169:2.5: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmato ānandassa paccassosi.
an5.169:3.1: idhāvuso, sāriputta, bhikkhu atthakusalo ca hoti dhammakusalo ca niruttikusalo ca vyañjanakusalo ca pubbāparakusalo ca.
an5.169:3.2: ettāvatā kho āvuso, sāriputta, bhikkhu khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu, suggahitagāhī ca, bahuṃ ca gaṇhāti, gahitaṃ cassa nappamussatīti.
an5.169:3.5: imehi ca mayaṃ pañcahi dhammehi samannāgataṃ āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ dhārema:
an5.169:3.6: ‘āyasmā ānando atthakusalo dhammakusalo niruttikusalo vyañjanakusalo pubbāparakusalo’ti.
